summary.text: Nancy Gregory is the Democratic candidate for Idaho State Senate District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican Desi Burbank.
She was an at-large member of the Boise School District Board of Trustees from 2002 until September 14, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Nancy Gregory has a bachelor's degree in elementary education from Brigham Young University and has lived in Boise since 1990.
According to Ballotpedia, she has volunteered in classrooms, served on building and district committees, and served as a PTA/PTO president.
She founded the Treasure Valley PAGE (Parent Advocates for Gifted Education) in 1998 and is an Edufest board member.
